verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents a dedicated agent that researches, plans, and writes docs, opening PRs for review (mintlify-docs-4), plus automations that trigger this agent on schedules, repo pushes, or integration events (mintlify-docs-5), and an editor-embedded agent that edits pages/nav/settings and surfaces changes as reviewable PRs with preview URLs (mintlify-docs-13, mintlify-docs-17, mintlify-docs-25). Runtime probes confirm the write-access MCP server is live and properly auth-gated (mintlify-probe-rt-4), corroborating this isn't vaporware. missing for 10: independent/third-party hands-on account of the agent actually drafting a PR end-to-end (only first-party docs and an auth-gate probe, no external user report of the full draft-to-PR flow working).
